name: inkbloom
description: Inkbloom — a portrait sandbox of living inks that pile, flow, burn and bloom, and keep twenty secrets.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-game.mjs && node scripts/test-noise-random.mjs && node scripts/verify-sim.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-module-mocks --no-warnings scripts/test-save-guard.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs embedded
scripts.build:bundled: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_GAME_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_LIBS=true vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs bundled
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run audit:public && npm run build && npm run build:bundled
